A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IVX method is asymptotically valid, and in many cases, is also practically useful, in predictive regressions with highly persistent variables.
, when the data is not too short and the regressors are not too highly persistent, the IVX method is a good alternative to the usual GMM methods.
in predictive regressions, the IVX method is a useful tool for inference, provided that the finite sample corrections are taken into account.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of IVX in the presence of highly persistent regressors requires special care.
